records.process_description: Eligible students: any Bachelor student who has completed the module group "Introduction to English Literature and Linguistics" (ideally in their final semester; completion of a Bachelor Seminar in Linguistics is strongly recommended). Choosing/approaching a supervisor: prepare a draft outline, email a prospective supervisor, and book the thesis module with them; do not reuse exactly the same seminar-paper topic (related topics in the same field are allowed). Deadlines to contact a supervisor: by 30 April for a fall submission, by 30 November for a spring submission. Registering: book the Bachelor Thesis early via UZH’s module booking tool (booking deadlines in the course catalog). Outline due: first week of October (fall) or first week of March (spring). Submission: Dec 1 (fall) or June 1 (spring). Length: Linguistics 8,000 words (±10%); Literature 10,000 words (±10%). Submit print + PDF unless supervisor specifies otherwise. For non-response from a supervisor, send a one-week reminder, then contact englishstudies@es.uzh.ch. Official guidelines and templates are on the department website (Bachelor Thesis Guidelines; Writing Your Bachelor Thesis in Literature; module description).
